req.title: Player POST accepts nickname optionally
req.statement: The system shall accept POST /players/ payloads without a nickname field and treat nickname as optional.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-040 states that POST /players/ must accept payloads without a 'nickname' field, treating nickname as optional. The PlayerRequestModel in player_model.py has no 'nickname' field at all — the optional fields are middle_name, date_of_birth, abbr_position, team, league, and starting11. The requirement is validated by: (1) a positive test confirming a minimal valid payload (all required fields, no optional fields) returns HTTP 201; (2) a positive test confirming a payload with all optional fields present also returns HTTP 201; (3) a boundary test confirming that omitting each optional field individually still yields HTTP 201; (4) a negative test confirming that omitting a required field (first_name) yields HTTP 422; (5) a decision-table test covering the combination of required-only vs required+optional payloads. Squad numbers 27-99 are used to avoid conflicts with the 26 pre-loaded rows.

tests.name: test_post_player_without_optional_fields_returns_201
preconditions: Database contains 26 pre-loaded players with squad numbers 1-26
Squad number 27 does not exist in the database
actions: POST /players/ with only required fields: first_name, last_name, squad_number, position
expected: Response body contains id (UUID), first_name, last_name, squad_number, position
Optional fields (middle_name, date_of_birth, abbr_position, team, league, starting11) are null or absent
trace: R-PLAYER-040: system shall accept POST /players/ payloads without optional fields
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_player_without_optional_fields_returns_201():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "TestFirst",
        "lastName": "TestLast",
        "squadNumber": 27,
        "position": "Goalkeeper"
    }
    r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert body["firstName"] == "TestFirst"
    assert body["lastName"] == "TestLast"
    assert body["squadNumber"] == 27
    assert body["position"] == "Goalkeeper"
    assert "id" in body
    assert body["middleName"] is None
    assert body["dateOfBirth"] is None
    assert body["abbrPosition"] is None
    assert body["team"] is None
    assert body["league"] is None
    assert body["starting11"] is None

test_post_player_without_optional_fields_returns_201()

tests.name: test_post_player_omitting_each_optional_field_individually_returns_201
preconditions: Database contains 26 pre-loaded players with squad numbers 1-26
Squad numbers 29-34 do not exist in the database
actions: POST /players/ six times, each time omitting exactly one optional field
expected: Omitted field is null in response body
trace: R-PLAYER-040: each optional field individually absent must still yield 2xx
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_player_omitting_each_optional_field_individually_returns_201():
    base = {
        "firstName": "BVA",
        "middleName": "Mid",
        "lastName": "Test",
        "dateOfBirth": "1995-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
        "position": "Left-Back",
        "abbrPosition": "LB",
        "team": "Chelsea",
        "league": "Premier League",
        "starting11": False
    }
    optional_fields = ["middleName", "dateOfBirth", "abbrPosition", "team", "league", "starting11"]
    for idx, field in enumerate(optional_fields):
        payload = dict(base)
        payload["squadNumber"] = 29 + idx
        del payload[field]
        r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
        assert r.status_code == 201, f"Failed omitting {field}: got {r.status_code}"
        body = r.json()
        assert body["squadNumber"] == 29 + idx
        assert body[field] is None, f"Expected {field} to be None, got {body[field]}"

test_post_player_omitting_each_optional_field_individually_returns_201()

tests.name: test_post_player_decision_table_required_only_vs_required_plus_optional
preconditions: Database contains 26 pre-loaded players with squad numbers 1-26
Squad numbers 60 and 61 do not exist in the database
actions: POST /players/ with required fields plus all optional fields (squad 61)
Assert both return 201 and response bodies differ only in optional field values
expected: Required-only response has null optional fields
Full response has non-null optional fields matching submitted values
trace: R-PLAYER-040: nickname (and all optional fields) are optional; both payload variants must succeed
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_player_decision_table_required_only_vs_required_plus_optional():
    r1 = client.post("/players/", json={
        "firstName": "ReqOnly",
        "lastName": "Player",
        "squadNumber": 60,
        "position": "Right-Back"
    })
    assert r1.status_code == 201
    b1 = r1.json()
    assert b1["squadNumber"] == 60
    assert b1["middleName"] is None
    assert b1["dateOfBirth"] is None
    assert b1["abbrPosition"] is None
    assert b1["team"] is None
    assert b1["league"] is None
    assert b1["starting11"] is None
    r2 = client.post("/players/", json={
        "firstName": "FullOpt",
        "middleName": "Mid",
        "lastName": "Player",
        "dateOfBirth": "2000-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
        "squadNumber": 61,
        "position": "Right-Back",
        "abbrPosition": "RB",
        "team": "Arsenal",
        "league": "Premier League",
        "starting11": False
    })
    assert r2.status_code == 201
    b2 = r2.json()
    assert b2["squadNumber"] == 61
    assert b2["middleName"] == "Mid"
    assert b2["dateOfBirth"] == "2000-01-01T00:00:00.000Z"
    assert b2["abbrPosition"] == "RB"
    assert b2["team"] == "Arsenal"
    assert b2["league"] == "Premier League"
    assert b2["starting11"] is False

test_post_player_decision_table_required_only_vs_required_plus_optional()

from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_player_location_header_set_on_201():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "LocTest",
        "lastName": "Header",
        "squadNumber": 70,
        "position": "Goalkeeper"

    r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
